# Future of Marketing

> Future of Marketing is a podcast where hosts Mada Seghete (Upside), Ethan Smith (Graphite Growth), and Camille Ricketts (XYZ Venture Capital) interview CMOs and marketing leaders at companies like Notion, Figma, Datadog, Webflow, and Square about how AI is changing marketing strategy, go-to-market, and team structure.

## Site

- [Homepage](https://fom.xyz/): All episodes, hosts, and events.
- [RSS feed](https://fom.xyz/rss.xml): Full episode feed with descriptions.
- [Privacy Policy](https://fom.xyz/privacy)
